en.question: A long Claude Code session is approaching the context limit, but the developer wants to keep working on the same task. Which command is appropriate?

options.text: /clear, which removes the accumulated conversation and starts clean.
options.note: Clearing discards the task state the developer explicitly wants to keep.

options.text: /compact, which summarises the session and continues with less context.
/init, which regenerates the project memory file from the current repo.
options.note: /init creates or refreshes CLAUDE.md and does nothing to context size.

options.text: /model, which switches to a model offering a larger context window.
options.note: Switching models does not reduce accumulated conversation.

en.explanation: Compacting preserves task continuity while reducing the context. Clearing is right only when you are genuinely starting an unrelated task.
